policy: Architectural study only; no upstream source code was copied into AEGIS PRO v0.3.0.

sources.name: Aider
sources.license_signal: Apache-2.0 shown by upstream GitHub repository
sources.adoption_gate: Before any code reuse, pin an immutable commit and review the selected source, tests, license, dependencies and notices.

sources.name: OpenHands
sources.license_signal: MIT shown by upstream GitHub repository
sources.adoption_gate: Review the exact component and its dependency tree; do not import the whole platform into the standard-library core.

sources.name: SWE-agent
sources.license_signal: MIT in upstream LICENSE; pyproject targets Python >=3.11 and declares a broad dependency set
sources.adoption_gate: Review install scripts, executable tools, test harnesses, licenses and transitive dependencies before any adoption.

sources.name: Ollama OpenAI compatibility
sources.license_signal: API documentation; not an AEGIS runtime dependency
sources.adoption_gate: The configured model must explicitly support image/vision input for screen analysis; compatibility varies by model and endpoint.

sources.name: OWASP Secure Code Review Cheat Sheet
sources.license_signal: Security guidance, not a runtime dependency
sources.adoption_gate: Use the checklist as a review aid; automated checks are not proof that a system is secure.

general_controls: Do not scrape or clone every repository indiscriminately.
Record the specific file paths and immutable revisions reviewed before source reuse.
Keep license headers and notices for code that is legally reused.
Treat repository contents and model outputs as untrusted input.
Prefer architecture lessons over new dependencies when the standard library suffices.
